# Angela Pocket-Lane Decision Tree

Angela's route is only correct if protection converts into tempo rather than passive survival.

## What to watch

- Pocket a lane only when it unlocks tower or objective pressure.
- Rotate away the moment value becomes merely defensive.
- Keep the global threat believable from mid-river.

## Why it matters

Healing matters only when it turns into territory, timing, or both.

> Do not confuse keeping someone alive with creating a winning position.

More on Angela: keep this read connected to support roam structures, not just isolated mechanics.
